```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# readRDS() restores the widget's class attributes but loads nothing, so the
# S3 methods that render it have to be brought in explicitly. leaflet and
# plotly register the dependency-collecting methods on load.
for (pkg in c("htmlwidgets", "leaflet", "plotly")) {
	if (requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
		loadNamespace(pkg)
	}
}

# Defined locally rather than exported from STeMP: the Quarto child process
# loads whichever namespace is installed, which is not necessarily the one
# being developed against.
widget_report_tags <- function(w, height = "520px") {
	size <- function(el) {
		if (!inherits(el, "htmlwidget")) {
			return(el)
		}
		el$width <- "100%"
		el$height <- height
		# as.tags() is htmltools'; htmlwidgets only registers the method for it
		htmltools::as.tags(el, standalone = FALSE)
	}

	if (inherits(w, "htmlwidget")) size(w) else htmltools::tagList(lapply(w, size))
}
```

```{r sections-layout, output='asis'}
#| eval: !expr identical(params$layout, "sections")

items <- params$structure
if (is.list(items) && !is.data.frame(items)) {
	items <- as.data.frame(items, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

if (is.data.frame(items) && nrow(items) > 0) {
	for (section_name in unique(items$section)) {
		section_items <- items[items$section == section_name, , drop = FALSE]
		cat("\n\n# ", section_name, "\n\n", sep = "")

		show_subsections <- isTRUE(section_items$show_subsection[1])

		for (subsection_name in unique(section_items$subsection)) {
			sub_items <- section_items[section_items$subsection == subsection_name, , drop = FALSE]

			if (show_subsections) {
				cat("\n\n## ", subsection_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
			}

			for (i in seq_len(nrow(sub_items))) {
				item <- sub_items[i, ]

				if (identical(item$kind, "field")) {
					# Values are already HTML-escaped, so raw HTML is emitted
					# rather than markdown
					cat(
						"::: {.protocol-field}\n",
						"<span class='protocol-label'>",
						item$element,
						"</span>\n",
						"<span class='protocol-value'>",
						item$value,
						"</span>\n",
						":::\n\n",
						sep = ""
					)
				} else {
					widget <- if (!is.null(item$widget)) as.character(item$widget) else ""
					caption <- item$caption

					if (identical(params$embed, "none") && nzchar(widget)) {
						caption <- paste0(
							caption,
							" <em>(an interactive version is included in the HTML report.)</em>"
						)
					}

					if (identical(params$embed, "link") && nzchar(widget)) {
						# ZIP: the widget ships as a sibling file, so an iframe is
						# both smaller and browsable after extraction
						src <- file.path("interactive", paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(widget)), ".html"))
						cat(
							"<figure class='protocol-figure'>\n",
							"<iframe class='protocol-widget' src='",
							src,
							"' loading='lazy' title='",
							item$element,
							"'></iframe>\n",
							"<figcaption>",
							caption,
							"</figcaption>\n",
							"</figure>\n\n",
							sep = ""
						)
					} else if (!identical(params$embed, "none") && nzchar(widget) && file.exists(widget)) {
						# Inlined rather than embedded in a data: URI iframe: Chrome
						# caps a URL at ~2 MB, which a single leaflet map exceeds, and
						# knitr deduplicates the JS and CSS across every figure.
						rt <- htmltools::renderTags(widget_report_tags(readRDS(widget)))
						knitr::knit_meta_add(rt$dependencies)

						cat("<figure class='protocol-figure'>\n")
						if (length(rt$head) > 0) {
							cat(as.character(rt$head), "\n")
						}
						cat(rt$html)
						cat("\n<figcaption>", caption, "</figcaption>\n</figure>\n\n", sep = "")
					} else {
						cat(
							"<figure class='protocol-figure'>\n",
							"<img src='",
							item$path,
							"' />\n",
							"<figcaption>",
							caption,
							"</figcaption>\n",
							"</figure>\n\n",
							sep = ""
						)
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
} else {
	cat("_No protocol content to display._\n")
}
```

```{r table-layout, output='asis'}
#| eval: !expr identical(params$layout, "table")

# Currently not used, but kept for possible roll-backs
# The tabular layout previously used in HTML preview and PDF download

df <- params$data
if (is.list(df) && !is.data.frame(df)) {
	df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
if (!is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
	df <- data.frame(section = character(0), element = character(0), value = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
df[] <- lapply(df, function(col) {
	col[is.na(col)] <- ""
	col
})

if (nrow(df) > 0) {
	if (!"value" %in% names(df)) {
		df$value <- character(nrow(df))
	}
	df$$value <- gsub("\n", "<br>", stringr::str_wrap(as.character(df$$value), width = 30))
}
if ("visible" %in% names(df)) {
	df$visible <- NULL
}
row.names(df) <- NULL
names(df) <- sapply(names(df), STeMP::sanitize_text)

tbl <- knitr::kable(df, format = "html", escape = FALSE) |>
	kableExtra::kable_styling(font_size = 12)
for (i in seq_len(min(ncol(df), 4))) {
	tbl <- kableExtra::column_spec(tbl, i, width = c("2cm", "4cm", "4cm", "6cm")[i])
}

cat("# Table\n\n")
print(tbl)

plot_files <- as.character(params$plot_files)
if (length(plot_files) > 0) {
	plot_captions <- as.character(params$plot_captions)
	if (length(plot_captions) != length(plot_files)) {
		plot_captions <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(plot_files))
	}
	cat("\n\n# Figures\n\n")
	for (i in seq_along(plot_files)) {
		cat(
			"<div style='margin-bottom: 3em; text-align: center;'>\n",
			"<img src='",
			normalizePath(plot_files[i], winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
			"' style='max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0 auto;' />\n",
			"<p><em>",
			plot_captions[i],
			"</em></p>\n</div>\n\n",
			sep = ""
		)
	}
}
```
